scale: GO 2026-07-26, ChEBI lite 256 and 13 of the largest ORE 2015 EL ontologies

manifest.build: MBX_LEARNED_INCREMENTAL=false mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify on the laptop at 65a7591d for the lane and 790cffae for the base, copied to the benchmark host. The commit after 65a7591d, 82d64aed, changes only the memory reserved for a parallel normalization's merge and tests, and heap-nsc.txt measures its estimate.
manifest.reference: ELK 0.6.0 and Konclude 0.7.0-1138 through scripts/elk-compare/elk.sh (ElkClassify.java sha256 5f879733…, konclude.py sha256 42eb3da4…) from the store paths in env.txt
manifest.lock_note: run.sh.txt took the bench lock and the heavy lock once and held them for every process of the run, so nothing else ran beside it. env.txt gives the time and load average when each process started.

settings.elk_heap: 4g for GO and ChEBI lite, 10g for the ORE ontologies, as -Xms and -Xmx

method: One process per build or reasoner, ontology and thread count, the base build first and then the lane build, ELK and Konclude. el_classify's classifyMs holds each classification by a Saturation that reads the axioms in place, with indexMs, saturationMs and taxonomyMs the stages of the last one. ElkClassify's classifyMs runs from the creation of the reasoner to the end of precomputeInferences. Konclude's classifyMs is its log's total processing time less its parse. peakRssKib is each process's peak resident set. checks.txt compares the lane's taxonomies with the base's on both thread counts and the lane's on eight threads with one, byte for byte, and oracle/ compares each ELK and Konclude taxonomy with the lane's on one thread. taxonomy-sweep-atlas.txt compares the lane's taxonomies of GO, ChEBI lite and the 298 ORE 2015 EL ontologies on one and eight threads with the base's on atlas. heap-nsc.txt holds el_classify --heap on four threads on a Namespace instance for the base and commit 82d64aed, with the estimate and the counted heap.

checks.name: lane taxonomies equal the base's and are the same on one and eight threads
ELK and Konclude taxonomies against the lane's
checks.note: Konclude's GO taxonomy differs by the same 7 and 2 direct edges as in the earlier reference run, which come from GO's inverse property, as RESULTS.md describes. Every other comparison agrees.
